description: Historical local capture preserved byte-for-byte. Added presentation assets do not change the recorded source identity.
transformation: For each plotted case, subtract the first admitted event elapsedMs, keep the original event sequence and counters, round to the recorded 0.01 ms precision, and draw post-step lines. Do not smooth, resample or extend lines beyond their last recorded event.
interpretation: The early-release control is intentionally incorrect. Overall report passed=true means the expected counterexample occurred; physicalBoundSatisfied and permitLifetimeValid remain false for that control.
cooperativeObservation: All four cooperative cancel-requested events in this capture have reason=deadline. Other implemented propagation paths are not asserted to have fired in this trace.

rendering.fonts: SVG glyphs are embedded. Regeneration requires an installed Korean font; font and library differences may change SVG bytes without changing plotted events.

limits: Real HTTP/socket cancellation surrounds synthetic timer-held work. This does not demonstrate cancellation of a database query, CPU task or external side effect.
Response deadlines and work durations are configured fixtures, not observed speed improvements or representative traffic.
Admission limits belong to this one inventory process. No global or cross-replica capacity bound is claimed.
Absolute deadlines use this shared host clock. Clock skew and authenticated cross-service deadline policy are outside this lab.
Cancellation is explicit and cooperative. The admission-only control deliberately ignores it and retains permits until real settlement.
The raw-event checker verifies recorded transitions, not uninstrumented work. Source hashes aid reproduction; they are not execution attestations.
